newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev up to 998-999 on mark, falls vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev up to 998-999 on mark, falls vs dlr.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev edged up to 998-999 per mark from 999-1,000 at the opening and Thursday's close as foreign currency demand fell after intensive buying for end-month position squaring in the past several days.
* Local banks have been more active on international markets, where the mark/dollar fell to 1.8540/60 at 1300 GMT from 1.8455/60 in the morning.
* The lev fell to 1,848-1,852 per dollar from 1,845-1,848 in the morning and 1,829-1,832 at Thursday's close.
* The lev has been pegged at 1,000 to the mark as an anchor under an IMF-prescribed currency board system, a fixed exchange rate mechanism introduced on July 1 to restore confidence in the lev.
* The interbank lev/mark exchange rate may deviate by up to 0.5 percent from the currency board peg. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
